evidenceKind: native Canvas / Skia raster output; NOT browser, deployed, or target-device evidence

runtime.exactFallbackSelection: Not instrumented; installed-family inventory does not prove the selected font.

source.bridge: Original makeAtlas, _put, _rasterize and render called in place. Legacy constructor not invoked. No browser APIs stubbed for raster capture.

gif.quantization: One shared 64-color palette, no dithering, delta frames; PNG originals are authoritative
gif.timing: Centisecond delays rounded cumulatively; final interval is 2 ticks. Tick 1110 is in native-final.png.

timing.note: Raw one-run native CPU/Skia timings including JS model and reused renderer; no warmup or browser/device acceptance. Draw timing pools replay/checkpoint/default/minimum/monochrome scenarios and excludes PNG encoding and GIF assembly.

unrun: Browser accessibility tree and assistive technology
